searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — deployment and release plan a commit is only a seed; awtsmoos.com publication is the fruit. the release closes only when github and the living public route agree on truth. before commit 1. refresh branch, head, status, and remote. 2. confirm procedural core files changed by this mission only. 3. reread every touched file. 4. run final critical structural/test/browser gates. 5. stage explicit related paths only; never git add .. 6. inspect complete staged diff and staged file list. 7. commit with focused message. concurrent upstream safety 1. fetch origin immediately after commit. 2. compare local commit base to origin/main. 3. if upstream moved and primary worktree has unrelated dirt, do not stash/rebase it. 4. use an isolated worktree/clone from fresh origin/main, cherry pick the verified mission commit, resolve only related conflicts, rerun critical gates. 5. push only the verified integrated commit chain. 6. verify github remote sha with git ls remote or equivalent. deployment discovery already observed repository contains scripts/bhrelease.mjs, immutable production deploy helpers, local snapshot publication, canonical server activation, nginx/production authority tooling, and deployment contract tests. this is not assumed to be github pages. publication gates inspect exact current release command/arguments; identify how commit/sha is embedded into the deploy artifact; run the repository supported release mechanism; verify deployment reports the intended sha/version; discover actual public route from configuration/output, not memory; http check it directly; open in a fresh browser session; exercise the universal demo/api and capture runtime/browser evidence.

canonical diagnostic structures rather than inventing incompatible error schemas. 16. keep world transaction state independent from semantic artifact compilation unless explicitly bridged. 17. make expert namespace names semantically unambiguous. 18. add a discoverable pipeline descriptor rather than dozens of top level inspection methods. 19. include examples for arbitrary unknown future kinds to prove noun neutrality. 20. include a constrained architectural example to prove graph semantics. 21. include a deferred operation example to prove capability honesty. 22. test deterministic plan/hash behavior across repeated runs. 23. test compile channel subsets. 24. test no executor side effects during plan/explain. 25. test legacy direct factories remain callable with unchanged shapes. 26. close inherited authored semantics tests before claiming stability. 27. inspect current deployment scripts immediately before release because shared production tooling may move. 28. re actual delta, github sha, deployment sha, and public route all prove closure.
